subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw expose an opt-in `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets CI gates pass while lower-severity secrets-audit findings remain reported?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and backward-compatible by default, but the new CLI flag changes how operators may gate credential-audit findings, which is a security/operations policy choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor the current opt-in flag
options.body: Accept the public threshold contract as written because the default remains strict and the report still shows lower-severity findings.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller contract, such as aligning naming with doctor lint, stronger docs around `status: findings`, or limiting threshold use to explicit check mode.

options.title: Pause or close this direction
options.body: Keep `secrets audit --check` strict until the broader audit truthfulness and cleanup policy in the linked issue is decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the current opt-in flag
recommendation.body: Accept the public threshold contract as written because the default remains strict and the report still shows lower-severity findings.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh introduced and expanded the secrets audit/configure/apply flow that this public audit-gate contract extends.
